find.intro: Type what you know: a code, a reading, a part, a meaning or a 破字 formula. Spaces separate clues, and each clue narrows the list.

rhymes.title: Guangyun rhyme tables
rhymes.intro: Pick a rhyme. Columns are the initials, rows are grade and tone, and each cell holds a small rhyme of the Guangyun.
rhymes.source: Data: nk2028 tshet-uinh-data (CC0), through TshetUinh.js. For the printed tables, see Web韻圖 by 鈴木慎吾.
method.mcpdictTerms: Collected by 漢字音典 (MCPDict, MIT code). The project asks to be told of copyright concerns; this table's own terms were not checked.
methods.unavailableIntro: These exist. A table for any of them would make it searchable.
convert.title: PUA conversion
convert.intro: Convert legacy private-use codes to Unicode. Codes not listed stay unchanged.
composition.title: Old composition formulas
composition.intro: Taiwan's 漢字構形資料庫 used thirteen symbols; Korean 破字 uses four arithmetic signs and a ▼. Paste either formula to convert it, or build one with a palette. Shape markers give their parts, and 破字's * and - map to the nearest IDS relations.
composition.hint: Connectors sit between parts; a repeat goes before its part.
composition.paja.title: Korean 破字
composition.paja.intro: The Korean History Database writes unencoded characters with arithmetic signs. This reads them into IDS.
composition.paja.placeholder: Paste a formula, or use a sign above
composition.paja.searchHint: Search finds characters that contain these parts; the exact structure is not required.
composition.paja.note.combine: * says only that the parts combine; the IDS uses overlap ⿻.
composition.paja.note.variant: ▼ marks a variant record and is left out of the IDS.
composition.paja.problem.unexpected: A grouping sign does not match.
composition.paja.problem.trailing: The formula has text after its end.
composition.paja.source: Korean History Database, 파자 검색 help
composition.paja.citation: Signs and examples follow the Korean History Database 破字 help (국사편찬위원회).
composition.placeholder: Paste an old formula, or use a symbol above
composition.parts: Parts after · keep their writing order. The old shape marker does not record their arrangement.
composition.problem.orphan: A connector has no part before it.
composition.problem.missing: A connector has no part after it.
composition.problem.repeat-missing: A repetition has no part after it.
composition.problem.mixed: The formula mixes connectors; only one kind may be used.
composition.problem.shape-connect: A connector appears inside a shape marker.
composition.problem.shape-chain: A shape marker cannot be joined with a connector.
composition.problem.shape-open: A shape marker is not closed.
composition.problem.shape-empty: A shape marker has no parts.
composition.problem.nested-shape: A shape marker appears inside another.
composition.source.citation: Symbols and shapes follow 莊德明, 〈構字式的處理技巧〉, 中央研究院資訊科學研究所, 2007.
